title: Grammar Transfer — Precision Check
description: Fresh sentences that retest agreement and commonly confused words.
subject: rla

questions.prompt: The list of required materials {{blank}} posted beside the laboratory door.

options.whyWrong: The nearby plural noun “materials” is inside a prepositional phrase. The true subject is the singular noun “list.”
This changes the sentence to past tense and also distracts from the singular subject.
This plural verb phrase does not agree with the singular subject “list.”

questions.explanation: The subject is “list,” which is singular. “Of required materials” does not change the subject, so “is” is correct.
questions.rule: Find the true subject before matching the verb; ignore nouns inside interrupting prepositional phrases.

questions.prompt: The technicians placed {{blank}} tools on the inspection table before beginning the test.
questions.explanation: “Their” is the possessive determiner needed directly before the noun “tools.”
questions.rule: Before a noun, use the possessive determiner “their”; “there” indicates place and “they’re” means “they are.”
